findings.detail: The pct-of-net-assets residuals are produced by using Common Unitholders' capital of 215,377,000 rather than the filing's net asset anchor, while representative source rows reconcile to their disclosed one-decimal percentages under rounding.

rationale: The raw filing shows Total Members' Capital of 207,019 thousand and a separate Common Unitholders' capital subtotal of 215,377 thousand. The flagged residual for D&D Buyer equals 528,672 - (0.3% * 215,377,000), showing the checker used the subtotal rather than the net-asset anchor. Against 207,019,000, the cited D&D Buyer and Signature Brands fair values are about 0.255% and 0.260% of net assets, which both round to the disclosed 0.3%. The source rows therefore support the disclosed values; the flag is caused by the check anchor/rounding basis, not a position data error.
